privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Privacy policy for A-Shine - how we collect, use and protect your personal data.
privacy.whoWeAreBody: A-Shine ("we", "us") is the data controller for personal data processed through this website. We provide car detailing and mobile valeting services in Slovenia. This policy explains how we process and protect your personal data in line with the GDPR and applicable Slovenian law.
privacy.dataWeCollectIntro: When you book an appointment or contact us, we may collect:
privacy.dataWeCollect3: Car type or model (if you provide it)
privacy.dataWeCollect4: Service, package, and location (at our location or we come to you, including distance)
privacy.dataWeCollect5: Preferred date and time, appointment status, language, and any message you send
privacy.howWeUse1: Create and manage your appointment in our booking calendar
privacy.howWeUse2: Hold the chosen time so it is not offered to someone else, and send a confirmation email to you and a notification to us
privacy.howWeUse3: Contact you about the appointment (for example by phone or email), send a reminder the day before, and confirm, reschedule, or cancel it
privacy.howWeUse4: Improve our services and customer communication
privacy.appointmentsStored: When you submit the booking form, we store an appointment record in our booking database. The record includes the details above, the start and end time (based on the service duration), and the status of the request (for example pending, confirmed, completed, or cancelled). Submitting the form reserves that time in our calendar. It does not by itself create a binding contract until we confirm the appointment.
privacy.appointmentsAccess: Appointment records are visible only to authorised A-Shine staff through a private admin account. They are not published on the website and are not visible to other customers. We also send a copy by email to our business inbox, a confirmation to the email address you entered, and a reminder the day before the appointment. Those emails are delivered by our email provider (Resend). Our website host (for example Vercel) delivers the public site. The booking database is hosted separately so we can keep the calendar.
privacy.appointmentsRetention: We keep appointment records for 24 months after the scheduled date, or for 24 months after cancellation if the appointment is cancelled earlier. After that we delete them, unless we must keep them longer to meet a legal obligation or to establish, exercise, or defend a legal claim. Your IP address may be processed briefly to limit abusive booking requests. It is not stored as part of the appointment record.
privacy.legalBasisBody: We process your data under Article 6 GDPR: (a) steps taken at your request before a contract, and performance of a contract once an appointment is confirmed; and (b) our legitimate interests in running the calendar, preventing double bookings and abuse, and communicating about the service. Where a legal obligation applies, we rely on that obligation.
privacy.sharingBody: We do not sell your data. Access to stored appointments is limited to authorised A-Shine staff. We share data only with processors that help us run the site, calendar, and email (website hosting, booking database hosting, and Resend), and with Google when you load the service-area map, under appropriate agreements and safeguards. We use reasonable technical and organisational measures, including access controls on the admin area.
privacy.additionalProcessors: Booking details are stored in our appointment database and are also sent through Resend so we receive a notification and you receive a confirmation. The public website is hosted on infrastructure such as Vercel, which may process technical data needed to deliver pages. When you view the service area map, Google (Maps JavaScript API and Geocoding API) may process technical data in line with Google's policies. International transfers, where they occur, rely on safeguards required by applicable law (such as Standard Contractual Clauses).
privacy.additionalSecurity: When you submit the booking form, our booking server may process your IP address briefly for rate limiting and abuse prevention. This is based on our legitimate interests in keeping the service secure and available. The IP address is not saved on the appointment.
privacy.additionalDevice: Your selected language is stored in your browser's local storage so the site can remember it. That storage does not contain your appointment details.
privacy.yourRightsBody: Under applicable data protection law (including GDPR where it applies), you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict processing of your personal data, and to data portability or to object to processing. To exercise these rights or ask questions, contact us at
privacy.yourRightsSuffix: . You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Slovenian Information Commissioner (Informacijski pooblaščenec).
privacy.changesBody: We may update this privacy policy from time to time to reflect legal, technical, or business changes. The "Last updated" date will be revised accordingly.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: Terms and conditions for using A-Shine website and booking our car detailing services.
terms.agreementBody: By using the A-Shine website and submitting an appointment request, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site or our services.
terms.servicesBody: A-Shine provides car detailing and mobile valeting services in Slovenia. Service areas, packages, and prices shown on the website are informational and may be adjusted based on vehicle condition, location, and requested scope. An appointment becomes binding only after we explicitly confirm it (for example by email or phone).
terms.bookingsBody: When you choose a date, time, and service and submit the form, we store an appointment request and hold that time in our calendar so the same slot is not offered to someone else. The request starts as pending. It is not a binding contract until we confirm the appointment, the final scope, and the price. We may decline the request or propose another time if we cannot carry out the service. Payment terms (for example payment on completion or a deposit) are agreed before the work is done. You are responsible for accurate contact, vehicle, and location details. Confirmation emails, and a reminder the day before, are sent through Resend. We are not liable for delays caused by spam filters, an incorrect address, or a third-party outage.
terms.cancellationBody: If you need to cancel or move an appointment, contact us as soon as possible. We will update or cancel the stored appointment. Until we confirm the change, the original time may stay reserved. Any notice period or cancellation fee is told to you when we confirm the appointment.
terms.useOfWebsiteBody: You must use the website lawfully and not attempt to interfere with its operation, security, or other users. Content on the site (text, images, etc.) is owned by us or our licensors and may not be copied or used without permission.
terms.liabilityBody: We perform services with due professional care. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded under applicable law, including mandatory consumer protection rules in Slovenia. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages.
terms.contactPrefix: For questions about these terms, contact us at
terms.contactSuffix: . These terms are governed by Slovenian law. We may update these terms from time to time; the "Last updated" date will be revised accordingly.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: How A-Shine uses cookies and similar technologies on this website.
cookies.whatAreBody: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make sites work properly, remember preferences, and understand how visitors use the site.
cookies.howWeUseIntro: Our website uses or may use:
cookies.localeStorageNote: Your selected language is saved in your browser’s local storage (not in a first-party cookie). You can remove it by clearing site data for this website in your browser settings.
cookies.necessaryDesc: Required for the site to function (e.g. security, load balancing). These generally do not require consent under applicable law.
cookies.functionalDesc: Optional cookies for UI preferences if we enable them. Your language choice is stored in local storage, not cookies (see above).
cookies.analyticsDesc: We do not currently use first-party analytics cookies on this site. If we add analytics later, we will only use cookies according to your consent where the law requires it.
cookies.thirdPartyBody: Our site can embed Google Maps (Maps JavaScript API and Geocoding API). When the map loads, Google may set or read cookies and process technical data according to Google’s terms and policies. We do not control Google’s cookies; adjust your browser or Google account settings as needed.
cookies.managingBody: We do not set any first-party cookies and our site does not display a cookie consent banner because of that. If you wish to block or delete the cookies set by Google Maps, use your browser settings or your Google account preferences.
cookies.updatesBody: We may update this cookie policy from time to time to reflect legal or technical changes. The "Last updated" date at the top will be revised accordingly.
cookies.contactPrefix: If you have questions about our use of cookies, contact us at
